title: Combat tactics
source: CCombatTactic::LoadKey (0x38900, 9 keys) read out of the game: reversing/findings/FINDINGS-definitions.md; what each figure does: reversing/findings/FINDINGS-combatview.md section 11

patterns.desc: a combat tactic, named by its key

tactic.desc: a tactic a land battle can pick

trigger.desc: when a side may pick it, judged in a scope of both the country and the combatant

aggressiveness.desc: the aggressiveness it suits; the further a side's from it, the less likely

attacker.desc: change to the attacker's damage, a fraction

defender.desc: change to the defender's damage, a fraction

movement_speed.desc: change to movement speed, a fraction
